propose.title: Add Terp Network's FIAB DAO to ZecHub DAO
propose.description:
## Background
Terp Network is a public, community-run Cosmos SDK blockchain. Its FIAB DAO is a community subDAO on Terp Network, and it now holds a cross-chain account on Juno so it can take part in DAOs here directly.

returniflost is a member of Terp Network who has been building experience across the full stack of Cosmos SDK projects, and is now looking to contribute that experience to ZecHub.

## Why?
- returniflost intends to contribute to and participate in ZecHub DAO.
- Specifically, returniflost wants to operate a Penumbra validator on behalf of the ZecHub community.
- Joining through the FIAB DAO's cross-chain account keeps this participation accountable to a DAO, rather than to a single wallet.

## Proposal
Add the following account as a ZecHub DAO member with a voting weight of 1:

`juno1hafmtgxpruf5kzrrwftnxccuer46534e7z5t0jl4g4le66x8kkysrcgj9y`

This account is the cross-chain account of the FIAB DAO on Terp Network.

## Action
If this vote passes, the account above is added to ZecHub DAO as a member with weight 1. From there, returniflost (through the FIAB DAO) will take part in ZecHub governance and work with the community on running a Penumbra validator on its behalf.
